title: Feature Geometry and Safety: Are Dangerous Concept Features Clustered or Dispersed in Activation Space?
original_idea: Using GPT-2 Small with pretrained SAE, curate three feature sets (dangerous, related benign, unrelated benign). Compute pairwise cosine similarities within/across groups. Test clustering with permutation test.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Useful for practical monitoring system design, but the connection from feature geometry in GPT-2 Small to deployed monitoring systems is indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Pretrained SAE available. Manual feature curation is time-consuming but doable. Cosine similarity and permutation tests are simple. Feature identification requires judgment.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Manual feature curation introduces subjectivity and effort. Three groups, pairwise comparisons, permutation test. Scope depends heavily on curation quality.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
